posts.title: In Your Bag
posts.description: Some years ago I solved one of my problems as a fan of film photography. How do I transport my kit from place to place, such as for family holidays? I’m not talking about actually carrying and using a film camera — that’s the easy bit! I came up with the idea of buying a ‘ peli’ case and creating cut-out for the cameras, accessories and lenses. posts.title: Buying Things Remixed
posts.description: Back in March 2012 I wrote three principles for myself for when I buy stuff. Thinking back on this, it has stood the test of time, but I think 14 years later I now favour those below (with the originals in bold ). It should be a ‘ need’ and not a ‘ want’.
